title: Each top on the wellbore's path
description: Each top's measured depth lies within the measured depths of the first and last station of the wellbore's newest readable path (a survey or a well path), both ends included. Depths in m are compared as written and in ft times 0.3048; any other unit on either side gives no context. Datums stated on both sides (not empty, not unknown) that differ after trimming and case-folding give no context. A top without a measured depth is not compared. Each top outside the path fails; its example depth and value are its measured depth as written. Offline the rule does not apply.

words.template: {count} tops lie outside the wellbore's path, the first at {first}.
